stem: The first emitter on a line delivers the expected volume, but several far-end positions underdeliver. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Run a representative output/uniformity check and investigate pressure, filtration or line effects
Assume the whole line is correct because the first emitter passed
Increase all schedules without measuring distribution
rationale: A single emitter cannot represent the whole irrigation network. Spatial output data are needed to diagnose distribution problems.
